mapper.select: SELECT TO_CHAR(T.CODE_NO) AS CODE_NO, NVL(GET_GLOBAL_NAME(T.CODE_NO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}), ' ') AS CONTENT, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(C.REPORT_NO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS REPORT_NAME, C.URL_JSP FROM (SELECT X.CODE_NO, ROWNUM AS RN FROM (SELECT S.CODE_NO FROM SY_CODE S WHERE S.ACTIVITY = 1 START WITH S.PARENT_CODE_NO = #{parentCodeNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC} CONNECT BY PRIOR S.CODE_NO = S.PARENT_CODE_NO ORDER SIBLINGS BY S.ORDERNO) X) T JOIN REPORT_CENTER C ON TO_CHAR(C.REPORT_TYPE_NO) = TO_CHAR(T.CODE_NO) WHERE C.ACTIVITY = '1' AND C.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER BY T.RN, C.ORDERNO
mapper.sql: (NVL(C.TEACHER_COST, 0) + NVL(C.MATERIAL_COST, 0) + NVL(C.FIELD_COST, 0) + NVL(C.FOOD_COST, 0) + NVL(C.STAY_COST, 0) + NVL(C.TRAFFIC_COST, 0) + NVL(C.VISA_COST, 0) + NVL(C.OTHER_COST, 0))
(SELECT COUNT(1) FROM EDU_FREE_EMPLOYEE FE WHERE FE.BASIC_NO = B.BASIC_NO)

CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(B.IMPLE_CLASS_UNIT) = '2' THEN TO_NUMBER(B.IMPLE_CLASS_HOUR) WHEN TO_CHAR(B.IMPLE_CLASS_UNIT) = '1' THEN TO_NUMBER(B.IMPLE_CLASS_HOUR) * 24 WHEN TO_CHAR(B.IMPLE_CLASS_UNIT) = '0' THEN TO_NUMBER(B.IMPLE_CLASS_HOUR) * 30 * 24 ELSE 0 END

CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(B.IMPLE_CLASS_UNIT) = '2' THEN TO_NUMBER(B.IMPLE_CLASS_HOUR) WHEN TO_CHAR(B.IMPLE_CLASS_UNIT) = '1' THEN TO_NUMBER(B.IMPLE_CLASS_HOUR) * 8 WHEN TO_CHAR(B.IMPLE_CLASS_UNIT) = '0' THEN TO_NUMBER(B.IMPLE_CLASS_HOUR) * 30 * 8 ELSE 0 END
SUM() AS ALL_COST, SUM() AS DIRECT_COST, SUM() AS INDIRECT_COST
COUNT(*) AS COUNTS, SUM() AS NUMB, SUM() AS ALL_TIME, SUM() * SUM() AS TOTAL_PT,

T.COUNTS, T.NUMB, ROUND(T.COUNTS / NULLIF(T.NUMB, 0), 2) AS AVG_COUNTS, T.ALL_TIME, T.TOTAL_PT, ROUND(T.ALL_TIME / NULLIF(T.NUMB, 0), 2) AS AVG_TIME, T.ALL_COST, T.DIRECT_COST, T.INDIRECT_COST, ROUND(T.ALL_COST / NULLIF(T.NUMB, 0), 2) AS AVG_COST

COUNT(*) AS COUNTS, COUNT(E.EMPID) AS NUMB, ROUND(COUNT(E.EMPID) / COUNT(*), 2) AS AVG_COUNTS, SUM(TO_NUMBER(B.IMPLE_CLASS_HOUR)) AS ALL_TIME, ROUND(SUM(TO_NUMBER(B.IMPLE_CLASS_HOUR)) / NULLIF(COUNT(E.EMPID), 0), 2) AS AVG_TIME, COUNT(E.EMPID) * SUM(TO_NUMBER(B.IMPLE_CLASS_HOUR)) AS TOTAL_PT, ROUND(SUM() / NULLIF(COUNT(E.EMPID), 0), 2) AS AVG_COST,

FROM EDU_BASIC_INFORMATION B JOIN EDU_FREE_EMPLOYEE E ON E.BASIC_NO = B.BASIC_NO JOIN EDU_COST_MANAGER C ON C.BASIC_NO = B.BASIC_NO JOIN EDU_PLAN_MANAGER P ON P.PLAN_NO = B.PLAN_NO JOIN HR_EMPLOYEE H ON H.EMPID = E.EMPID AND H.CPNY_ID = B.CPNY_ID WHERE B.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
T.COUNTS, T.NUMB, T.AVG_COUNTS, T.ALL_TIME, T.TOTAL_PT, T.AVG_TIME, T.ALL_COST, T.DIRECT_COST, T.INDIRECT_COST, T.AVG_COST
mapper.select:
SELECT GET_GLOBAL_NAME(T.POST_GRADE_NO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS GROUP_NAME, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(T.TRAIN_FORM_CODE, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS TRAIN_FORM_NAME,
FROM (SELECT H.POST_GRADE_NO, P.TRAIN_FORM_CODE,
AND CONVERTTOUNSIGN(UPPER(GET_GLOBAL_NAME(H.POST_GRADE_NO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}))) LIKE '%' || CONVERTTOUNSIGN(UPPER(#{postGradeName, jdbcType=VARCHAR})) || '%'
GROUP BY H.POST_GRADE_NO, P.TRAIN_FORM_CODE) T ORDER BY GROUP_NAME, TRAIN_FORM_NAME

SELECT GET_DEPT_NAME(T.DEPTNO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS GROUP_NAME, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(T.TRAIN_FORM_CODE, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS TRAIN_FORM_NAME,
FROM (SELECT H.DEPTNO, P.TRAIN_FORM_CODE,
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HR_DEPARTMENT D WHERE D.DEPTNO = H.DEPTNO START WITH D.DEPTNO = #{deptNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR} CONNECT BY PRIOR D.DEPTNO = D.PARENT_DEPT_NO)
GROUP BY H.DEPTNO, P.TRAIN_FORM_CODE) T ORDER BY GROUP_NAME, TRAIN_FORM_NAME
